findings.finding: A new install operation context defaults appendTeamID to true.
Preferred installed identity is reused only when the resigned bundle identifier contains the Team identifier. Otherwise, the default path appends the Team identifier.
The ordinary refresh pipeline does not run the user-customization step. Install and update pipelines run it.
The AppID customization dialog can disable appending the Team identifier for a full IPA install. The manual choice is stored only in that operation context.

inference: For this existing prototype identifier, ordinary one-tap refresh is expected to request a profile for a different identifier. It cannot be assumed to renew the current app correctly.
chosenTrial: In-place full IPA re-signing from Files on the iPad, with Customize AppID enabled and Append Team ID unchecked each time.
trialSequence: Adopt build 6 into SideStore without changing the installed identity.
Reimport build 6 to test renewed provisioning without a code update.
Import build 7 to test a controlled update.
